headline: Oil Rises To 100.03 From 99.29 As The Gain Widens To 2.96 Percent
narrative: Oil rose to 100.03, a 2.96 percent gain, from 99.29 and a 2.2 percent gain. Silver fell to 54.31, a 5.42 percent loss, from 54.54 and a 5.02 percent loss, while gold fell to 4,029.1, a 2.91 percent loss, from 4,037.5 and a 2.71 percent loss. The oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the higher print means crude cash value rose through 100, and the metals pipe is the cash price of silver and gold, so the wider losses mean those cash values fell.
author: jordan
